comment: The text states that the metadata registries and LHR “make up REDDHI,” but Section 2.2 defines REDDHI more broadly as a maturing condition supported by governance, interoperability, standards, terminology, consent, trust, and resilience.

public.text: The text states that the metadata registries and LHR “make up REDDHI,” but Section 2.2 defines REDDHI more broadly as a maturing condition supported by governance, interoperability, standards, terminology, consent, trust, and resilience.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with a sentence like: “form part of the essential technical foundation for progress toward REDDHI.” Avoid equating a set of components with REDDHI itself.
